text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about speeding along Kenilworth Avenue and have requested that traffic calming measures (speed humps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed hump) on Kenilworth Avenue (west branch) between Queen Street East and the north end of Kenilworth Avenue (west branch). 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install one speed hump on Kenilworth Avenue (west branch) between Queen Street East and the north end of Kenilworth Avenue (west branch), generally as shown on the attached Drawing No. TC-107, dated November 2022, from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
